title: HR - Manager / Plant HR (Must Be from Textile & Apparel Industry)
description:
Role: HR Manager/Plant HR
 Department: Human Resources Location: North Karnataka
 Job Summary: The HR Manager will support plant HR operations, focusing on end-to-end plant HR Operations, manpower planning, statutory compliance, employee relations, and smooth workforce management. The role involves handling both white-collar and blue-collar workforces in a factory environment. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Recruitment & Workforce Planning Recruitment management: hiring for plant roles (Blue Collar) Coordinate with department heads for manpower requirements Handle bulk hiring and onboarding 2. Statutory Compliance Ensure compliance with labor laws (PF, ESI, Bonus, Gratuity, Factory Act) Maintain statutory registers and records Coordinate inspections (labor officer, factory inspector) Handle audits and documentation 3. Employee & Industrial Relations Handle shop-floor employee grievances Maintain discipline and implement company policies Drive employee engagement activities for workers 4. HR Operations Manage attendance, shift rosters, and leave records Oversee onboarding and exit formalities Maintain employee files and documentation 5. Payroll Coordination Work closely with the payroll team for wage processing Verify attendance and overtime Ensure statutory deductions compliance 6. Training & Development Identify training needs for workers and staff Conduct induction programs for new hires Support safety and skill development training 7. Health, Safety & Welfare Support the implementation of safety policies Coordinate health check-ups and welfare activities Ensure compliance with EHS standards 

 Required Skills Strong knowledge of labor laws & factory compliance Experience handling a blue-collar workforce Good communication Conflict resolution and problem-solving skills Ability to work in a plant/shift environment 
 
 Desired Candidate Profile Master of Social Work (MSW) degree from a recognized institution. Minimum 8-12 years of experience in Human Resources or a related field. Strong understanding of HR operations, including plant Operations, recruitment management, payroll processing, attendance management, grievance handling & redressal. Proficiency in Labour Laws & Statutory Compliance; ability to stay updated on regulatory changes. Must be from the Textile & Apparel Industry

Key Skills: Grievance Handling,Labour Laws,Employee Relations,HR Operations,Statutory Compliance,Payroll Management,Plant HR,Employee Engagement
